# 07-evaluation - Evaluation

## Why this topic exists

Without an evaluation, a change to an agent is a guess. This topic covers how these benchmarks are constructed, what that construction makes measurable, and what it necessarily leaves out. Read it before the multi-agent papers, so that claims about coordination have somewhere to land.

## Prerequisite topics

- [`02-acting-and-tools`](../02-acting-and-tools/README.md) Acting and tools
